Сначала — не занята ли она другой програ: First: whether another program has taken it. A shortcut registered system-wide (Ctrl+Alt+digit especially) never reaches the app at all, and nothing on the app's side can change that. Quick check: if the same key does nothing in another program either, Relay is not the culprit. The cure is rebinding it in “Settings → Keyboard shortcuts” — which also lists every current combination, the conflicts between them, and a “Reset all” button.
Это отдельные комплекты возможностей, и: These are separate feature packs, switched on in “Settings → Plugins”: AI assistant, gRPC, WebSocket, Server-Sent Events, Socket.IO, MQTT, “Advanced Authorization” (Digest, OAuth 1.0, AWS v4, Hawk, NTLM and the other schemes), “Extra panes” (more than four panes), “Extra languages” (German, Spanish) and “Extra backup formats” (.sqlite, ZIP). A pack that is off costs no memory and shows none of its sections — which is why the instructions for the assistant lead nowhere until it is enabled. Сертификат сервера подписан корнем, кото: The server's certificate is signed by a root that is not on the trusted list: an internal or test certificate, or HTTPS being intercepted by an antivirus or a corporate proxy. The quickest fix is the “Turn off SSL verification” button right in the error — in the response card or in a pre-request script's pop-up message. Verification is then off for every request, for pm.sendRequest and for redirects to other hosts; turn it back on in “Settings → General”. To keep verification, add the root certificate (.pem) in “Settings → Network” — public sites keep being verified.
Соединения открываются при действиях пол: Connections open on user actions: sending a request, connecting over a protocol, running the runner, a script with pm.sendRequest, the “Check now” button in About, and requests to the AI provider and to plugins with network permission when they are enabled. There are no background update checks, telemetry or crash reports.
Через pm.sendRequest с колбэком — песочн: With pm.sendRequest and a callback — the sandbox runs a classic script, so top-level await does not work there: pm.sendRequest({ url, method: "POST", body: { mode: "urlencoded", urlencoded: [{ key: "grant_type", value: "client_credentials" }] } }, function (err, r) { if (err) { console.log(err); return } pm.globals.set("token", r.json().access_token) }). Every body mode is understood — urlencoded, raw (with options.raw.language), formdata and graphql. The request goes through the same engine as a normal send, so with your TLS, CA, proxy and client-certificate settings, and waits for the answer within the request timeout. Check err before response.json(): on an error there is no response.
